patch_description: A completely restructured, symmetry-aware ansatz that replaces the ring CZ entangler with a single-parameter CRX ring over the outer tic-tac-toe ring and a hub entangler using CRY gates from center to edge qubits. This design increases parameter efficiency while boosting expressive power by leveraging a ring-based rotationally symmetric entangler (CRX_ring) and a compact hub-connector (CRY_hub_edge). It preserves the same inputs/outputs and overall training loop, but uses a different, potentially more expressive parameter-sharing scheme to improve validation accuracy and reduce train-test gaps.
